class: A question about one entry sent to the AI without the entry, and a picked value shown as a tag read as empty
symptom: Steelcase (Avature), second run, 29 September: the AI answered 'Country of Institution' with India for the Eastern Illinois University degree, having been asked only 'Country of Institution'; and the Institution search box, which shows the picked school as a tag inside it, was read as empty, so the school was typed again on every pass and the tag was taken for a question of its own.
site: Avature (Steelcase); any form with per-entry questions or search-and-pick boxes
root_cause: The single-question AI call carried only the box's label, so the same words for two degrees got one answer (and the per-run memory would have given the second the first one's). parse_snapshot read a combobox's value only from its own line, and Avature draws the picked value as a child textbox named by the choice.
why_tests_missed: The AI-question tests used questions that name their subject; the tag tests covered Workday's '1 item selected' text, not a tag drawn as a child text box.
fix: For a box inside a job or degree entry, the question sent to the AI names the entry (repeated_entries.describe: 'Country of Institution (for: Masters of Science in Computer Technology, Eastern Illinois University)'). A text box inside a combobox, named other than the combobox and not a search prompt, is the combobox's picked value and not a control.
prevention: Every question handed to a model carries the context that makes it one question (which entry, which section); and every way a site shows a chosen value -- text beside, a tag, a child box -- has a fixture.
